_note: Facts Low<F>/High<F> mean the reading is below the 10th / above the 90th percentile of the recommended crop's training rows (data-derived, not invented). F: N P K Temperature Humidity Ph Rainfall.

advice.Irrigate: Irrigate: rainfall is low (and the air is dry or hot) compared with what this crop usually gets.
advice.AddNitrogen: Nitrogen is low: apply a nitrogen-rich fertilizer (e.g. urea or compost/manure).
advice.AddPhosphorus: Phosphorus is low: apply a phosphorus fertilizer (e.g. single super phosphate).
advice.AddPotassium: Potassium is low: apply a potash fertilizer (e.g. muriate of potash).
advice.ReduceNitrogen: Nitrogen is already high: skip nitrogen fertilizer this cycle to avoid waste and runoff.
advice.ReducePhosphorus: Phosphorus is already high: skip phosphorus fertilizer this cycle.
advice.ReducePotassium: Potassium is already high: skip potash this cycle.
advice.CorrectAcidity: Soil is more acidic than this crop prefers: consider liming after a local soil test.
advice.CorrectAlkalinity: Soil is more alkaline than this crop prefers: consider gypsum or sulfur after a local soil test.
advice.CheckDrainage: Rainfall is high for this crop: make sure fields drain well to avoid waterlogging.
advice.ScoutForDisease: Wet and humid conditions favour fungal disease: scout the crop regularly.
advice.HeatStress: Temperature is above this crop's usual range: consider mulching, shade or irrigating in the cooler hours.
advice.ColdStress: Temperature is below this crop's usual range: consider protecting young plants or delaying sowing.
